title: Visitor and Portrait
author: Xanthe Amberdale
blurb: Wendell Quintana, a radio host taking calls from listeners who died last week, documents everything, because documentation is a kind of prayer. Then the sleep recordings capture a second voice answering questions — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must get the family out ahead of the count before the last resident signs the papers.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
